newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP plans Foster's sale by June - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP plans Foster's sale by June - paper.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd aimed to sell its 37 percent stake in Foster's Brewing Group Ltd by its May 31 balance date and said it aimed to sell A$4 billion in assets over the next two years, The Australian Financial Review reported on Thursday, citing market sources.

"Analysts said yesterday the comments by company representatives during investor presentations confirmed BHP was prepared to accept bids for its Foster's shares," the Financial Review said. Canadian brewer Molson Companies Ltd was believed to have offered A$2.50 per share to the buy the stake, the newspaper said.
Foster's shares closed up two cents at A$2.56 on Wednesday, above BHP's book value of A$2.33 for the shares.
The Financial Review said it was believed that after a successful Molson bid for the stake, Foster's would then make a scrip bid for Molson Breweries, which is owned by Molson Companies.
This would deliver Molson more than 50 percent control of Foster's, the newspaper said.

"It has also been suggested that BHP has received bids of A$2.50 a share, including a break-up scenario from Brierley Investments Ltd, that would leave the Australian-based Carlton and United Breweries as the only remaining division," the Financial Review said.
The Foster's board was also believed to be fine-tuning a buy-back of the BHP shareholding to avert a change in ownership, it said.
